heading: EXT. ROOFTOP OF A DEFUNCT BOWLING ALLEY - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. ROOFTOP OF A DEFUNCT BOWLING ALLEY - NIGHT
A flat tar roof with a giant fiberglass bowling pin tilted at one corner.
Orange glow of a distant highway.
Six teenagers sit in a rough circle around a dying cooler.
MAYA OSEI (17, braids, denim jacket) holds the last warm soda.
LUCAS BRANDÃO (17, skinny, borrowed varsity jacket) fiddles with a lighter.
TILLIE VANCE (16, hair dyed green, headphones round her neck) lies flat on her back.
DARIUS PEÑA-OKAFOR (18, quiet, a duffel at his feet).
ROSALIE MAHMOUD (17, glasses, scholarship folder under her arm) sits cross-legged.
And FINN ASHWORTH-DIOP (16, the youngest, hoodie sleeves over his hands) has pulled his knees to his chin.
Darius stands.
Lucas tracks him with the lighter flame.
Tillie sits up on one elbow.
Maya turns her head.
Rosalie closes her folder.
Finn pulls the sleeves further down.
Darius lifts the duffel and slings it over his shoulder as if it were weightless.
So, that's it. Bus is at six.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: Six in the morning?
units.name: TILLIE

units.text: Yeah.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: That's, like, five hours.
units.name: TILLIE

units.text: Yeah.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: You said next week.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: I said I'd tell you when I knew. Now I know.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: Lucas clicks the lighter shut.
That's messed up, man.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: Luc.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: No, it is. You get a whole summer's notice and you give us five hours?
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: I didn't want it to be a thing.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: It's a thing.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: Finn rubs his eye with a sleeve.
Nobody sees except Tillie.
You good?
units.name: TILLIE

units.text: I'm fine. Dust.
units.name: FINN

units.text: There's no dust. It's a roof.
units.name: TILLIE

units.text: Darius sets the duffel down again.
He walks to the giant bowling pin at the corner and leans against it, looking out at the highway.
You can all come to the bus.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: We're coming to the bus.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Obviously we're coming to the bus.
units.name: LUCAS

units.text: I'll bring snacks.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: Silence.
Then Tillie sits up, takes her headphones off her neck, and holds one earbud out to Darius across the circle.
Come listen to something stupid with me.
units.name: TILLIE

units.text: Darius hesitates.
Then crosses the roof and sits beside her.
She puts the bud in his ear.
Maya leans on Rosalie.
Lucas lights the lighter again and holds it up like a concert, and one by one, they all pretend not to be crying.
